front: Shape three needles from a piece of your metal and fling them at a target with a spell attack. They can cause bleeding; the metal returns to you.
back:
Spell attack vs. AC. Deals 3d4 piercing. Needles carry the metal's special properties (e.g. cold iron weakness).
Crit Success: double damage and 1 persistent bleed damage.
Success: full damage.
Heightened (+1): one more needle: +1d4 damage and +1 persistent bleed on a crit.
